slots.rationale: Adds independently trainable thumb-joint corrections as spin approaches or falls below the required speed, while leaving rates above 5.25 rad/s unaffected and assuming no roll direction.

Lets training selectively amplify or attenuate the reference actions during spin shortfalls, targeting the dominant slow-spin failures while preserving the reference's episode-dependent roll direction.
